name: HedgeCoverV1.04
summary: HedgeCover is a hedging EA that opens opposing positions to cover existing trades when the market moves against them. It uses a coverage-based approach where counter-positions are triggered at configurable distance intervals to protect against adverse price movement, aiming to net out losses through correlated opposing trades.
summary_zh: HedgeCover是一个对冲保护EA，当市场走势对持仓不利时，通过开立反向仓位来覆盖现有交易。它采用覆盖式方法，在可配置的距离间隔触发反向头寸，以对抗不利价格变动，旨在通过相关反向交易来净额抵消亏损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是对冲覆盖（Hedge Cover），当市场价格朝不利方向移动一定点数后，自动开设反向头寸来对冲风险。入场条件是基于原始持仓的浮亏达到设定阈值，触发反向对冲单，形成锁定浮亏的状态。出场条件通常是对冲单和原始单一起平仓，当净损益达到目标或市场价格回归时实现盈利出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或递增手数方式开设对冲单，部分版本支持多层对冲。资金管理方面依赖参数控制最大对冲层数和单层手数上限，但没有严格的止损机制，更多依赖对冲锁定来控制风险。整体策略属于防守型，适合震荡行情但面临单边趋势时多层对冲可能导致保证金不足。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is hedge coverage, which automatically opens opposing positions to hedge risk when the market price moves adversely beyond a set threshold. Entry conditions are based on the floating loss of the original position reaching a configurable trigger distance, at which point a counter-hedge order is placed to lock in the floating loss. Exit conditions typically involve closing both the hedge and original positions together when net profit reaches a target or when the market price reverts favorably. Position sizing uses fixed lots or incremental lot sizes for hedge orders, with some versions supporting multiple hedge layers. Money management relies on parameters controlling maximum hedge layers and per-layer lot size limits, but lacks a strict stop-loss mechanism, depending more on hedge locking to control risk. The overall strategy is defensive, suitable for ranging markets, but faces margin insufficiency risk during strong trending conditions with multiple hedge layers.

parameters.name: HedgeDistance
parameters.description_en: Distance in points to trigger hedge

parameters.name: HedgeProfitTarget
parameters.description: 对冲组合止盈目标(金额)
parameters.description_en: Hedge group profit target in account currency

pros: 对冲机制可以在不利行情中锁定浮亏，避免单边止损造成实际亏损
多层对冲设计提供了分步风险管理，比一次性止损更灵活
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据品种和账户调整对冲距离和层数
pros_en: Hedging mechanism locks floating losses in adverse markets, avoiding actual loss from one-sided stop-outs
Multi-layer hedge design provides stepwise risk management, more flexible than a single stop-loss
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust hedge distance and layers per instrument and account
cons: 单边趋势行情中多层对冲会消耗大量保证金，存在爆仓风险
缺乏硬性止损，极端行情下对冲可能无法及时执行
对冲锁仓后解锁策略不够明确，可能导致长期持仓占用保证金
cons_en: Multi-layer hedging in trending markets consumes significant margin, risking margin call
Lack of hard stop-loss means hedges may not execute timely in extreme market conditions
Unlocking strategy after hedge lock-in is unclear, potentially leading to prolonged margin-occupying positions
improvements: 增加硬性止损作为最终安全网，防止极端行情爆仓
优化对冲解锁逻辑，添加自动解仓条件避免长期锁仓占用保证金
improvements_en: Add a hard stop-loss as a final safety net to prevent margin calls in extreme markets
Optimize hedge unlock logic with automatic unlock conditions to avoid prolonged margin-occupying locked positions

risk_points: 多层对冲在单边趋势中可能耗尽保证金导致爆仓
缺乏硬性止损，极端滑点或跳空行情下对冲可能失效
对冲锁仓后解锁时机不明确可能导致长期浮亏无法实现
risk_points_en: Multi-layer hedging can exhaust margin in strong trends leading to margin call
No hard stop-loss means hedges may fail during extreme slippage or gap events
Unclear unlock timing after hedge lock-in may result in unrealized floating losses over extended periods

summary_en: HedgeCover is a hedging EA that opens opposing positions to cover existing trades when the market moves against them. It uses a coverage-based approach where counter-positions are triggered at configurable distance intervals to protect against adverse price movement, aiming to net out losses through correlated opposing trades.
